title: Silver foil cupcake molds
text: Silver foil cupcake molds. Silver foil cupcake "papers"... these are super handy and pretty too. They are regular cupcake size. Fit into regular muffin pan size. I use with savory baked goods that have a little more oil. No soaking or leaking or weakened paper. Perfect.
